lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਜਿਥੈ ਹੀ ਤਉ ਵੰਞਣਾ ॥੫੮॥
lines.transliteration: saaee jaai samhaal jithai hee tau va(n)njanaa ||58||
lines.translation: Remember that place where you must go. ||58||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਕੰਮੜੇ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa jinhee ka(n)mee naahi gun te ka(n)maRe visaar ||
lines.translation: Fareed, those deeds which do not bring merit - forget about those deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਸਰਮਿੰਦਾ ਥੀਵਹੀ ਸਾਂਈ ਦੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੫੯॥
lines.transliteration: mat sarami(n)daa theevahee saa(n)ee dai darabaar ||59||
lines.translation: Otherwise, you shall be put to shame, in the Court of the Lord. ||59||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਦਿਲ ਦੀ ਲਾਹਿ ਭਰਾਂਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa saahib dee kar chaakaree dil dee laahi bharaa(n)d ||
lines.translation: Fareed, work for your Lord and Master; dispel the doubts of your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਵੇਸਾਂ ਨੋ ਲੋੜੀਐ ਰੁਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਜੀਰਾਂਦਿ ॥੬੦॥
lines.transliteration: daravesaa(n) no loReeai rukhaa(n) dee jeeraa(n)d ||60||
lines.translation: The dervishes, the humble devotees, have the patient endurance of trees. ||60||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਾਲੇ ਮੈਡੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਕਾਲਾ ਮੈਡਾ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa kaale maide kapaRe kaalaa maidaa ves ||
lines.translation: Fareed, my clothes are black, and my outfit is black.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨਹੀ ਭਰਿਆ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ॥੬੧॥
lines.transliteration: gunahee bhariaa mai phiraa lok kahai daraves ||61||
lines.translation: I wander around full of sins, and yet people call me a dervish - a holy man. ||61||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੀ ਤੋਇ ਨ ਪਲਵੈ ਜੇ ਜਲਿ ਟੁਬੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tatee toi na palavai je jal tubee dei ||
lines.translation: The crop which is burnt will not bloom, even if it is soaked in water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੋ ਡੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਰਬ ਦੀ ਝੂਰੇਦੀ ਝੂਰੇਇ ॥੬੨॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa jo dohaagan rab dee jhooredee jhoorei ||62||
lines.translation: Fareed, she who is forsaken by her Husband Lord, grieves and laments. ||62||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਤਾ ਚਾਉ ਵੀਵਾਹੀ ਤਾਂ ਮਾਮਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) kuaaree taa chaau veevaahee taa(n) maamale ||
lines.translation: When she is a virgin, she is full of desire; but when she is married, then her troubles begin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਏਹੋ ਪਛੋਤਾਉ ਵਤਿ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਨ ਥੀਐ ॥੬੩॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa eho pachhotaau vat kuaaree na theeai ||63||
lines.translation: Fareed, she has this one regret, that she cannot be a virgin again. ||63||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਛਪੜੀ ਆਇ ਉਲਥੇ ਹੰਝ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalar keree chhapaRee aai ulathe ha(n)jh ||
lines.translation: The swans have landed in a small pond of salt water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਜੂ ਬੋੜਨੑਿ ਨਾ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਉਡਣ ਸੰਦੀ ਡੰਝ ॥੬੪॥
lines.transliteration: chi(n)joo boRanhi naa peevahi udan sa(n)dee da(n)jh ||64||
lines.translation: They dip in their bills, but do not drink; they fly away, still thirsty. ||64||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਉਡਰਿ ਕੋਧ੍ਰੈ ਪਇਆ ਲੋਕੁ ਵਿਡਾਰਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n)s udar kodhrai paiaa lok vidaaran jaai ||
lines.translation: The swans fly away, and land in the fields of grain. The people go to chase them away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਲਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੰਸੁ ਨ ਕੋਧ੍ਰਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੬੫॥
lines.transliteration: gahilaa lok na jaanadaa ha(n)s na kodhraa khaai ||65||
lines.translation: The thoughtless people do not know, that the swans do not eat the grain. ||65||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਈਆਂ ਪੰਖੀਆਂ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਵਸਾਏ ਤਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: chal chal gaeeaa(n) pa(n)kheeaa(n) jinhee vasaae tal ||
lines.translation: The birds which lived in the pools have flown away and left.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਸਰੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਭੀ ਚਲਸੀ ਥਕੇ ਕਵਲ ਇਕਲ ॥੬੬॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa sar bhariaa bhee chalasee thake kaval ikal ||66||
lines.translation: Fareed, the overflowing pool shall also pass away, and only the lotus flowers shall remain. ||66||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਟ ਸਿਰਾਣੇ ਭੁਇ ਸਵਣੁ ਕੀੜਾ ਲੜਿਓ ਮਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa it siraane bhui savan keeRaa laRio maas ||
lines.translation: Fareed, a stone will be your pillow, and the earth will be your bed. The worms shall eat into your flesh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਵਾਪਰੇ ਇਕਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੬੭॥
lines.transliteration: ketaRiaa jug vaapare ikat paiaa paas ||67||
lines.translation: Countless ages will pass, and you will still be lying on one side. ||67||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੰਨੀ ਘੜੀ ਸਵੰਨਵੀ ਟੁਟੀ ਨਾਗਰ ਲਜੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa bha(n)nee ghaRee sava(n)navee tutee naagar laj ||
lines.translation: Fareed, your beautiful body shall break apart, and the subtle thread of the breath shall be snapped.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਫਰੇਸਤਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਠੀ ਅਜੁ ॥੬੮॥
lines.transliteration: ajaraaeel pharesataa kai ghar naathee aj ||68||
lines.translation: In which house will the Messenger of Death be a guest today? ||68||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਭੰਨੀ ਘੜੀ ਸਵੰਨਵੀ ਟੂਟੀ ਨਾਗਰ ਲਜੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa bha(n)nee ghaRee sava(n)navee tootee naagar laj ||
lines.translation: Fareed, your beautiful body shall break apart, and the subtle thread of the breath shall be snapped.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਜਣ ਭੁਇ ਭਾਰੁ ਥੇ ਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਆਵਹਿ ਅਜੁ ॥੬੯॥
lines.transliteration: jo sajan bhui bhaar the se kiu aavahi aj ||69||
lines.translation: Those friends who were a burden on the earth - how can they come today? ||69||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਬੇ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ਕੁਤਿਆ ਏਹ ਨ ਭਲੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa be nivaajaa kutiaa eh na bhalee reet ||
lines.translation: Fareed: O faithless dog, this is not a good way of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੀ ਚਲਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਪੰਜੇ ਵਖਤ ਮਸੀਤਿ ॥੭੦॥
lines.transliteration: kabahee chal na aaiaa pa(n)je vakhat maseet ||70||
lines.translation: You never come to the mosque for your five daily prayers. ||70||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਠੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਉਜੂ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੁਬਹ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: uth phareedaa ujoo saaj subah nivaaj gujaar ||
lines.translation: Rise up, Fareed, and cleanse yourself; chant your morning prayer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਾਂਈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਪਿ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥੭੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo sir saa(n)ee naa nivai so sir kap utaar ||71||
lines.translation: The head which does not bow to the Lord - chop off and remove that head. ||71||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਾਈ ਨਾ ਨਿਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਂਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sir saaee naa nivai so sir keejai kaa(n)i ||
lines.translation: That head which does not bow to the Lord - what is to be done with that head?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁੰਨੇ ਹੇਠਿ ਜਲਾਈਐ ਬਾਲਣ ਸੰਦੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੭੨॥
lines.transliteration: ku(n)ne heth jalaaeeai baalan sa(n)dai thaai ||72||
lines.translation: Put it in the fireplace, instead of firewood. ||72||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਿਥੈ ਤੈਡੇ ਮਾਪਿਆ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਤੂ ਜਣਿਓਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa kithai taide maapiaa jinhee too janiohi ||
lines.translation: Fareed, where are your mother and father, who gave birth to you?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਓਇ ਲਦਿ ਗਏ ਤੂੰ ਅਜੈ ਨ ਪਤੀਣੋਹਿ ॥੭੩॥
lines.transliteration: tai paasahu oi lad gae too(n) ajai na pateenohi ||73||
lines.translation: They have left you, but even so, you are not convinced that you shall also have to go. ||73||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਦਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਟੋਏ ਟਿਬੇ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa man maidaan kar toe tibe laahi ||
lines.translation: Fareed, flatten out your mind; smooth out the hills and valleys.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵਸੀ ਦੋਜਕ ਸੰਦੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੭੪॥
lines.transliteration: agai mool na aavasee dojak sa(n)dee bhaahi ||74||
lines.translation: Hereafter, the fires of hell shall not even approach you. ||74||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖਾਲਕੁ ਖਲਕ ਮਹਿ ਖਲਕ ਵਸੈ ਰਬ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa khaalak khalak mahi khalak vasai rab maahi ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the Creator is in the Creation, and the Creation abides in God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੭੫॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)daa kis no aakheeai jaa(n) tis bin koee naahi ||75||
lines.translation: Whom can we call bad? There is none without Him. ||75||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿ ਦਿਹਿ ਨਾਲਾ ਕਪਿਆ ਜੇ ਗਲੁ ਕਪਹਿ ਚੁਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa j dihi naalaa kapiaa je gal kapahi chukh ||
lines.translation: Fareed, if on that day when my umbilical cord was cut, my throat had been cut instead,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਵਨਿ ਨ ਇਤੀ ਮਾਮਲੇ ਸਹਾਂ ਨ ਇਤੀ ਦੁਖ ॥੭੬॥
lines.transliteration: pavan na itee maamale sahaa(n) na itee dukh ||76||
lines.translation: I would not have fallen into so many troubles, or undergone so many hardships. ||76||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਬਣ ਚਲਣ ਰਤੰਨ ਸੇ ਸੁਣੀਅਰ ਬਹਿ ਗਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaban chalan rata(n)n se suneear bahi gae ||
lines.translation: My teeth, feet, eyes and ears have stopped working.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇੜੇ ਮੁਤੀ ਧਾਹ ਸੇ ਜਾਨੀ ਚਲਿ ਗਏ ॥੭੭॥
lines.transliteration: heRe mutee dhaah se jaanee chal gae ||77||
lines.translation: My body cries out, "Those whom I knew have left me!" ||77||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਬੁਰੇ ਦਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਸਾ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਹਢਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa bure daa bhalaa kar gusaa man na hadhaai ||
lines.translation: Fareed, answer evil with goodness; do not fill your mind with anger.
